body: I would be interested in attending. https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9865

I would like to attend for:
- https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9360 (Add back/forward cache NotRestoredReasons)
- https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/8972 (Add steps to destroy documents that are ineligible for receiving message when posting message through broadcast channel)
- https://github.com/w3c/webappsec-clear-site-data/pull/77 (https://github.com/w3c/webappsec-clear-site-data/pull/77)
I added you both and tagged the topics with agenda+ (except for the webappsec one, I'll add that to the meeting notes separately).

Thank you all for attending today! Here are the notes from this meeting (the next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9909):

### Agenda  
Attendees: Michael Smith, Joey Arhar, Panos Astithas, Fergal Daly, Sanket Joshi, Olli Pettay

1. Review past action items
    1. Panos will tag Simon and Alastor on [Add TextTrackCue ctor & cue + cuebackground attributes](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9771).
        1. [Done](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9771#issuecomment-1773179118).
    1. Domenic and Hiroshige to comment on [Use inside settings to fetch the descendants of module worker in the worker module script graph](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9571).
        1. Hiroshige needs more time to discuss this with his team.
    1. Domenic and Hiroshige to comment on [Should throw SecurityError when loading a worker with a cross-origin script](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9794).
        1. [Done](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9794#issuecomment-1776727660).
    1. Olli will review [Fix errors related to <slot> elements in auto directionality traversal](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9868).
        1. [Done](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9868#pullrequestreview-1693032387).
1. Carryovers from last time
    1. None.
1. New topics
    1. [Fergal] [Add steps to destroy documents that are ineligible for receiving message when posting message through broadcast channel](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/8972)
        1. Chrome and Firefox agree that we should spec something here, perhaps starting with a conservative approach. We need Anne to provide feedback from WebKit.
    1. [Gavin] [subcaption / nested caption tag](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9865)
        1. Will discuss when the proposer is available to present the topic.
    1. [Fergal] [Add back/forward cache NotRestoredReasons](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9360)
        1. Agreement to proceed with the conservative approach for now. Agreement to use an object to display a message in devtools. Yuzu will update the PR.
    1. [Fergal] [Add section for BFCache eviction in cache clearing](https://github.com/w3c/webappsec-clear-site-data/pull/77)
        1. Olli is supportive and will discuss it internally next week. Will comment on the issue afterwards.
    1. [Joey] [Event bubbling and which events are blocked in disabled form controls](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/2368#issuecomment-1791479865)
        1. Agreement that double-click should be blocked when click is blocked.

### Action Items

1. @annevk to provide feedback on [Add steps to destroy documents that are ineligible for receiving message when posting message through broadcast channel](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/8972).
1. @rubberyuzu to update [Add back/forward cache NotRestoredReasons](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9360).
1. @smaug---- to comment on [Add section for BFCache eviction in cache clearing](https://github.com/w3c/webappsec-clear-site-data/pull/77).
